goal: Translate the frozen Plaza visual rules into an event-native editorial page resembling the official ONE PIECE event system without copying Plaza layout.

requiredDirection.surface: warm-white map-paper page with dark navy limited to masthead or contained promotional media
requiredDirection.hero: contained rectangular event identity/banner; title and status remain immediately legible and do not become a full-screen dark poster
requiredDirection.composition: event identity -> key metrics -> rectangular round schedule/content islands -> top-deck action
requiredDirection.geometry: low-radius 1px rules; no dominant pill controls
requiredDirection.colorRoles: yellow sparse selection/attention; red event/action marker; navy structure; preserve semantic status colors
requiredDirection.type: strong event title and numeric hierarchy with restrained CJK labels/body

mustNotDo: replace Pokémon event content with ONE PIECE copy
let character art carry recognition alone
change other routes or business behavior
acceptance: 390/536/1280 show event identity, status and first useful schedule/action within a sensible first-screen budget
event and round navigation pointer/keyboard behavior remains unchanged
zero overflow, clipping and external writes
